CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2524 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b. Bus nonce: cd011a9bf3abe01097887890ee40fefd. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b` or `Fix review: blocked 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: cd011a9bf3abe01097887890ee40fefd`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2524 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2524-cd011a9b`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2524 (branch fix/r10-pusher-reap, group R10-PUSHER-REAP) at head 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b, after fixer round fix2524c on the blocked verdict at c071fa5f37abdac0da2284547b9282549eb4d607 (harness: class-rule-missing: the body stated three pusher seams and named no enumeration rule; tools/audit/seat/handoff_push.sh ran app_push.sh as an untrapped foreground child, leaving 4 of 4 tree pids alive when TERMed). The round also merged origin/main through conflicts in tools/audit/seat/handoff_push.sh, pr_args.sh and update_pr.sh; the body should carry a ## Conflict resolution section.
Read every open block with `git fetch origin review/2524; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` and confirm each is cleared at this head: (a) a stated enumeration rule for pusher seams that covers handoff_push.sh, cloud_relay.sh and merge_train.py's recarry subprocess, applied and checked (enumerate every caller of app_push.sh / push paths yourself and compare to the rule); (b) the pr-contract refusal of 3 unrouted body items; (c) the app_push.sh pr_signal_traps / EXIT pr_reap / KILL-escalation / EXIT-backstop mutation survivors, pinned or triaged in writing.
Check the conflict resolution: each conflicting hunk keeps both main's added checks and this PR's reap/trap behaviour (git diff against both parents). Re-run the TERM harness: TERM the pusher tree and count surviving pids (expect 0) at this head, and the null control at the base.
Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head, with the finder's harness (the earlier verdict's ev/ tree), never the fixer's. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Every body figure re-measured at this head; carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body 0 unrouted, every carry to a live group; ## Red checks from check-runs per commit (nightly-status grades main; main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT); git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b clean. ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: cd011a9bf3abe01097887890ee40fefd.
